newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Financial to redeem preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Financial to redeem preferred stock.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd said Thursday it called for redemption on December 2 all of its outstanding eight percent cumulative convertible exchangeable preferred stock.
The redemption price for the preferred stock is $26.78 a share, plus accrued and unpaid dividends from October 1 to December 2. The total redemption price is $27.12 a share.
Holders have the option of converting their preferred stock to Olympic common stock at a rate of 4.662 shares for each preferred, or $5.3625 per common share, the company said.
The conversion right expires December 2. Olympic common was trading at $15.875 per share in midmorning.
There were 312,822 preferred shares outstanding on October 30, the Olympic said.
